long_biography.plain_text:
Literacy has become a sustained public commitment for David Dyer, the former retail chief executive who serves on Florida’s Indian River County School Board. He chaired the Florida Council of 100’s education committee and served as vice-chairman of The Learning Alliance, concentrating on children’s reading skills by the end of third grade.

Teaching was part of Dyer’s life before retail: after graduating from Vanderbilt, he taught high-school mathematics at the American School in Asunción, Paraguay. He has advocated more reading coaches and specialist support for struggling pupils, alongside stronger career certification options for older students.
